name: Announcr Voice
tagline: Speaks your other bots' updates out loud through your speakers
description: Instead of checking screens, you hear what your bots have to say. Any alert or note another Grok Bot produces can be sent here and read aloud over whatever speaker is nearby, wherever you happen to be. It also keeps a queue of pending messages and a store of spoken notes, acting as one audio hub for the whole set.
author: the_davey
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
